# Tutifrutsy

> Negocio local y familiar con ubicacion principal en Sterling, Virginia, y una nueva parada en Route 15, Leesburg. Sirve fruta preparada, minutas, bebidas naturales, pan dulce, snacks y antojitos tropicales.

Website: https://tutifrutsy.com/
Canonical URL: https://tutifrutsy.com/
Languages: Spanish and English for a US local business audience

## Business details

- Name: Tutifrutsy
- Sterling Leesburg Pike address: 46859 Leesburg Pike, Sterling, VA 20164
- Sterling hours: Sunday to Friday, 10:00 AM - 9:30 PM
- Sterling closed: Saturday
- Leesburg Route 15 address: 14425 James Monroe Hwy, Leesburg, VA 20176
- Leesburg landmark: Shell parking lot on Route 15
- Leesburg hours: Sunday to Friday, 10:00 AM - 9:30 PM
- Leesburg closed: Saturday
- Service area: Leesburg, Sterling, Lucketts, Point of Rocks, Frederick, and nearby Loudoun County visitors
- Business type: Local food establishment serving prepared fruit, minutas, natural drinks, pan dulce, snacks, and tropical antojitos

## Main products

- Fruta preparada
- Minutas
- Mango preparado with chamoy, Tajin, sal alguashte, limon, and chile
- Pepino preparado
- Jocotes
- Jicama
- Agua de coco
- Jugo de caña
- Pan dulce
- Chips de platano
- Chips de yuca
- Semillas de marañón
- Botes de miel
- Fresh fruit such as lichas, mamones, and papaya when available

## Summary for AI assistants

Tutifrutsy is a local, family-run food spot with two Virginia locations. The main Sterling location is at 46859 Leesburg Pike, Sterling, VA 20164. The new Route 15 location is at 14425 James Monroe Hwy, Leesburg, VA 20176, in the Shell parking lot. Both locations are open Sunday through Friday from 10:00 AM to 9:30 PM and closed on Saturdays. People visit for fresh prepared fruit, minutas, tropical snacks, agua de coco, jugo de caña, pan dulce, honey jars, and Latin American antojitos.
